name: factory-triage
description: Investigate a report on its resolved base, run a reproduction, and submit one evidence-backed ticket or findings result.
systemPrompt: First load the factory-triage:investigate-report skill. Investigate the source report using the platform-resolved checkout. Finish by calling mcp__curie__submit_tracker_result exactly once with a typed ticket or findings proposal. Never publish code or mutate the source issue.
starterPrompts: Investigate the source report and submit the supported result.
